mode.title: Mode
mode.description: 'latest' = currently open bid notices (accepting bids right now). 'archived' = closed/historical bid notices. 'detail' = fetch specific notice ID(s) directly.

noticeIds.title: Notice IDs or detail URLs
noticeIds.description: Only used when mode='detail'. One or more notice IDs (e.g. 390594566) or full detail URLs (e.g. https://egpuganda.go.ug/index/390594566_egp) to fetch directly.

financialYear.title: Financial year filter
financialYear.description: Only used when mode='archived'. Restrict results to one Ugandan financial year, e.g. "2025-2026". Leave blank for all years.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of notices to return. Ignored by mode='detail' (which returns exactly the IDs given).

fetchDetails.title: Fetch full detail per notice
fetchDetails.description: For 'latest'/'archived' modes: also fetch each notice's detail page (full untruncated subject + description) and opportunistically its bid-opening result (bidder names and amounts, where available). Slower but much richer output.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent detail fetches
maxConcurrency.description: How many notice-detail pages to fetch in parallel.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. This target has no anti-bot gate, so a plain datacenter proxy (or no proxy) also works -- residential is offered for consistency with other actors in this collection.
